Thanks for the context. I reviewed the sample lines and the cert. Summary and recommended routing below.

Summary (per jurisdiction):
- EU (Novatel Ireland Ltd, VAT IE1234567): B2B supply of electronically supplied services. Reverse-charge applies if the invoice is issued to the Irish VAT-registered entity and we can validate the VAT number via VIES. Evidence needed: copy of VAT cert (they provided) + VIES lookup result.

- UK (Novatel UK Ltd, VAT GB987654321): Post-Brexit, UK VAT rules differ. If we supply to a UK VAT-registered business and services are used in the UK, standard VAT may apply unless treated as outside the scope. For SaaS/hosting, typically we charge UK VAT unless the place of supply is outside UK. Evidence needed: VAT registration number + company registration link or vendor profile. If they want self-bill, we can accept but need a signed self-billing agreement and early settlement terms.

- India (Novatel India Pvt Ltd, GSTIN 27ABCDE1234F1Z5): Inbound services into India from a non-resident supplier generally attract reverse-charge under GST for certain services; however, taxation often depends on place of supply and whether Novatel's entity is the recipient liable under RCM. Evidence needed: GSTIN copy + confirmation of recipient (Novatel India) being the entity consuming the service. For our collections, finance may need to withhold or provide instructions to AP to remit GST if RCM applies.

Practical routing recommendation:
1) Issue separate invoice lines grouped by legal entity (IE / UK / IN) on a single PDF proforma so Novatel sees a single document but we have distinct tax treatments per entity.
2) EU lines: mark as reverse-charge (0% VAT) pending VIES validation; include 'reverse charge — art. 194' style note on line.
3) UK lines: charge VAT if they cannot provide a signed self-billing agreement OR confirm place-of-supply outside UK. Otherwise we'll propose self-bill.
4) India lines: flag as 'RCM possible — await GSTIN confirmation'; do not release invoice to Collections for settlement until GST treatment is confirmed.

Minimal evidence checklist for Novatel to provide to unblock payment:
- VAT cert (company-provided) + VIES validation screenshot or URL for IE ID.
- UK company registration link or signed self-billing agreement.
- GSTIN screenshot from GST portal for India.

I'll draft a one-page mutual action plan and a proforma showing tax codes for each line. Rishi — please confirm whether Finance can accept split settlement on the same invoice (separate GL/tax codes) or whether you prefer separate invoices per legal entity.

— Soojin
